answer: For a poll on a quartz and onyx sundial at zenith, officials lock a $10 deposit per ballot. Anyone may challenge a ballot; officials check the voter's ID against the resident roll and refund the deposit if it matches, but reject the ballot and forfeit the deposit otherwise. Unchallenged ballots are counted and refunded. Extra ballots tie up $10 each. Borrowed IDs can pass, and challenges can burden genuine voters.
